body:
## Advanced Beacons
**Advanced Beacons adds 5 beacon tiers with increased range, multiple potion effects per beacon, and no need for a huge pyramid of material blocks.**

Do you want to improve vanilla beacons? Then Advanced Beacons might be for you.
Advanced Beacons adds 5 new beacon tiers to the game, each with its own crafting recipe. Every tier increases the beacon’s range and allows multiple potion effects per beacon, meaning you no longer need to place several beacons just to access all effects.
No large pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, or netherite blocks is required.
Additionally, Advanced Beacons can add more potion effects to beacons. This feature can be completely disabled for a more vanilla friendly experience.

---

💡 **Features**
- ➕ Increased beacon range up to **256 blocks**
- ➕ Multiple potion effects per beacon
- ✖️ No material pyramid required
- 🌍 Supports English and German (players can choose their own language)
- 📝 Config options for messages, GUI text and vanilla friendly experience.

---

❓ **How to use**
To get started, you only need to craft an Advanced Beacon Tier 1 or better.
Tip: All recipes can be viewed ingame with `/advancedbeacons viewRecipe [1-5]`

### Crafting Recipe for an Advanced Beacon Tier 1:
![Picture of the crafting recipe for a advanced beacon tier 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53b1ef54fa6c17cdf947fd62de5a38fd2b96b416.png)

Resources: 
- 32x Gold Block
- 160x Iron Block
- 1x Netherite Ingot
- 1x Beacon

### Crafting Recipe for am Advanced Beacon Tier 2:
![Picture of the crafting recipe for an advanced beacon tier 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e9d6998cca27b56e47fa036341e6376f32ab2c1.png)

- 1x Nether Star
- 16x Ghast Tear

![Picture of the crafting recipe for an advanced beacon tier 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28db3ba2f7e067c4340446f8b4e746655296cbb1.png)

### Crafting Recipe for an Advanced Beacon Tier 4:
![Picture of the crafting recipe for an advanced beacon tier 4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd3f7cc0ee3c613c9a0072b87bc5900a5c364df2.png)

### Crafting Recipe for an Advanced Beacon Tier 5:
![Picture of the crafting recipe for an advanced beacon tier 5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc87faab6bb43a854fd491432d249bf830eaebbb.png)

### Beacon GUI with vanilla friendly setting enabled:
![Picture of the Beacon GUI with vanilla friendly option turned on](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce161f2163d51d642b2ad05ccd56e12d27c3fce1.png)

**Effects:** Speed, Haste, Jump Boost, Resistance, Strength, Regeneration

### Beacon GUI with more potion effects enabled:
![Picture of the Beacon GUI with all available effects](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bd823e465661251ae97d407b2902cfb3770c04a.png)

**Effects:** All vanilla effects listed above, plus Glowing, Night Vision, Slow Falling, Fire Resistance, Luck, Health Boost

---

🛠️ **Commands**
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/advancedbeacons setLanguage [English / Deutsch]` | Sets the display language for the executing player. |
| `/advancedbeacons giveBeacon [1-5]` | Gives an Advanced Beacon of the selected tier to the executing player. |
| `/advancedbeacons viewRecipe [1-5]` | Shows the crafting recipe of the selected tier. |

---

📄 **Permissions**
| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `advancedbeacons.command.setlanguage` | true | Allows the user to set their preferred display language |
| `advancedbeacons.command.viewrecipe` | true | Allows the user to view Advanced Beacon recipes |
| `advancedbeacons.command.givebeacon` | op | Allows the user to give themselves an Advanced Beacon of any tier |
